verdict.rationale: Smithery documented Triggers: consumers activate a trigger through Smithery, which proxies the subscribe call, and the server then POSTs events directly to the consumer. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says its Connect and API services, accounts, API keys, and service-tied SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and only a non-proxied public registry remains. The Smithery-mediated trigger subscription path is therefore no longer delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
